name: Fatima Group
desc: Pakistani conglomerate founded in 1936 spanning fertiliser, mining and oil and gas, textiles, sugar, healthcare, agritech and digital banking.
products: fertilisers (Sarsabz), textiles, sugar, mining, energy, hospital, Buraq Bank
marketing_autonomy_basis: group holding; own website and marketing division (Sarsabz)
stores_or_sites: fertiliser plants (Sadiqabad, Multan, Sheikhupura per Wikipedia Fatima Fertilizer article)
markets: Pakistan; fertiliser associate stake in Midwest Fertilizer (Indiana, USA); mining MoU in Algeria
profitability_basis: Group's listed affiliate Fatima Fertilizer: net income Rs. 36 billion (US$130 million) 2024 (Wikipedia)

signals.what: Fatima Fertilizer signed MoU with Algeria's Sonarem on phosphate mining at Bir el Ater
Globacore Minerals Ltd (mining) added to group

fit_rationale: Domestic Pakistani fertiliser and industrial conglomerate selling to farmers; no Pakistani Grand Prix and little international consumer brand, so Formula 1 fit is low despite scale.

access.roles: Group CEO; Group Head of Marketing / Corporate Communications

outstanding: Ownership (Mukhtar family trusts implied, not stated); Fatima Fertilizer itself is listed on PSX (excluded) - the prospect is the group.

name: Sunrise Medical
hq_city: Mount Juliet, Tennessee (US address on site)
desc: Manufacturer of manual and power wheelchairs, seating and mobility products under brands including Quickie, Zippie, JAY and Magic Mobility.
products: QUICKIE, ZIPPIE, JAY, WHITMYER, RGK, MAGIC MOBILITY, EMPULSE, LECKEY, Spinergy wheels
customers: mobility dealers, healthcare providers, wheelchair users
markets: sales offices in 24 countries, distribution in 130 countries (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific)

alt_indicators.evidence: sales offices in 24 countries, manufacturing sites in 10 countries, distribution across 130 countries

signals.what: Acquired Spinergy, performance wheelchair wheel brand
Launched LECKEY BeMe paediatric seating system

fit_rationale: Global wheelchair maker with athletes and Paralympic links; F1 engineering and lightweight-materials storytelling could suit its performance chairs, but buyers are health dealers, so hospitality value is limited.
f1_markets: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Germany (company site), Australia, Japan, China

access.roles: CEO; Chief Marketing Officer / VP Marketing

outstanding: Owner (PE?) and revenue not found on pages opened.
